caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length dress displayed on a plain, light-colored background. The dress has a fitted waist, a deep V neckline, and long, voluminous sleeves that end just below the elbow. The garment features an intricate pattern with leaf-like motifs throughout and is predominantly green with shades of olive and gold, giving it a textured appearance. The collar and cuffs have a contrasting trim in a reddish or burgundy color, and there is a visible fold indicating a wrap or overlap at the waist, likely secured with a fabric belt. The intricate decorative patterns cover the entirety of the dress, which flares outward towards the bottom, creating a sweeping, floor-length hemline. The dress's bodice and sleeves are constructed in a way that gives them a padded or quilted look, contributing additional dimension to the garment. The neckline features an inner, grayish underlayer visible beneath the V-cut. There are no other objects or background details present in the composition.
